RETURN POLICY FAQ
=================

Q: What is the standard return window?
A: Customers may return most items within 30 days of the original purchase date.

Q: What condition must items be in for a return?
A: Items must be in their original, unused condition with all original packaging and accessories.

Q: How do I start a return?
A: Log in to your account, navigate to Order History, select the order, and click "Request Return". You will receive a prepaid shipping label within 24 hours.

Q: Are there items that cannot be returned?
A: Digital downloads, gift cards, and perishable goods are non-returnable. Opened software and hygiene products are also excluded.

Q: When will I receive my refund?
A: Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item.
